name: O-RAN Testbed Automation (NIST)
what_it_is: An automation tool that deploys and configures 5G Open RAN testbeds based on NIST TN 2311 blueprints, supporting both bare metal and virtualized environments. It integrates OAI or srsRAN gNodeBs, Open5GS 5G core, Near-RT and Non-RT RICs, and xApps into a reproducible research testbed.
components: O-RAN SC Non-RT RIC M-Release (minimal prototype, no rApp support)
measurement: MAC, RLC, PDCP, GTP layer metrics (FlexRIC xApps)
KPM metrics exportable to console, CSV, or InfluxDB
configuration: Scenario 1: srsRAN or OAI gNodeB + O-RAN SC Near-RT RIC
VirtualBox VM settings: I/O APIC, PAE/NX, Nested VT-x/AMD-V, Nested Paging
Network attachment via NAT for local component communication
full_install.sh idempotent installer (resumes from failure point)
modes: run.sh — starts all components as background processes
Near-RT RIC auto-starts on boot, monitored via k9s -A
constraints: Requires Ubuntu 20.04, 22.04, or 24.04 LTS only — no other OS supported
Minimum hardware: 57 GB storage, 6000 MB RAM, 2 CPU cores (6+ recommended)
Stable internet required during installation; interruption requires full restart
Non-RT RIC is a minimal prototype with no rApp support
Near-RT RIC runs in Kubernetes and may enter CrashLoopBackOff if resources are insufficient
Not all component combinations are supported — verified connectivity documented in diagrams only
No docker-compose.yml present; orchestration is via Kubernetes (Near-RT RIC) and bare-process scripts
notable_absences: No docker-compose.yml found (404 on both main and master branches)
No fault injection or traffic impairment capabilities documented
No rApp support in Non-RT RIC
No RF hardware / SDR integration documented (software-radio only)
